chunks: And this report was narrated by Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Abu Dawud al-Munshid, from Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad, from Yunus, from Hammad ibn ʿUthman, from Abu ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the source of the report
key_terms.الْخَبَرَ: the report or hadith being transmitted
key_terms.عَنْ: from; indicating transmission in the sanad
key_terms.مِثْلَهُ: the same as it; indicating identical matn to the preceding report

ai.seo_question: What is the alternate chain of transmission for this hadith in Tahdhib al-Ahkam’s chapter on waters?
ai.summary: This entry provides an alternative sanad for the same hadith mentioned previously. It indicates that Imam Abu ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام transmitted the same report through this chain in the chapter on waters and their rulings.
